description: Finds a part's faces, edges or vertices by what they are, each with its persistent reference and shape: by the feature that made them, their geometry, a direction (a planar face's outward normal, or an edge's or cylinder's axis either way), or a point they contain or are near. Use it to get references to pass to other operations, such as the top face of Boss-Extrude1 or the circular edges of a hole. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The part: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

kind.description: What to find: face, edge or vertex.

feature.description: Only what this feature made (for an edge or vertex, any feature of a face it lies on): its name, or a reference exactly as a result gave it.

geometry.description: Only this shape, for example plane or cylinder for faces, line or circle for edges.

direction.description: Only faces whose outward normal points this way, or edges, cylinders and cones whose axis is parallel to it.

angle_tolerance_deg.description: How far from direction still counts, degrees, 0 to 90. Default 1.

near.description: Only what is within max_distance_mm of this point (mm), nearest first.

max_distance_mm.description: How far from near still counts, mm. Default 1. Needs near.

limit.description: At most this many, 1 to 1000. Default 50.
